extracted_information: Watermelon AI offers four main pricing plans: Basic, Premium, Business, and Enterprise. All prices are per month, billed annually, and a 25% discount is applied for yearly billing. Free trial options are available for Basic and Premium plans, while Business and Enterprise plans offer a free demo request. There is no explicit free tier with specific limitations mentioned beyond the chat limits associated with each paid plan.

additional_costs.Additional_AI_Agents: €99 per AI Agent per month (for Business plan, Customized for Enterprise)

pricing.chat_bundle_notes: If chat limit is reached, messages cannot be sent, and AI Agents become inactive. Upgrade to a higher bundle is required to continue.
